purpose: Freeze the previously unspecified deterministic implementation details of the diagnostic percentile bootstrap before any candidate-model inference.

bootstrap_execution.rng: Python standard-library random.Random (MT19937/Mersenne Twister), initialized once with integer seed 20260801 at report-assembly start.
bootstrap_execution.rng_reset: Do not reset between model-language cells.
bootstrap_execution.within_resample: For each cell and each of 10,000 replicates, draw 80 MCQ item scores with replacement first using equal-weight random.choices(k=80), then 40 generation item scores with replacement using equal-weight random.choices(k=40), and compute 100*(sum_mcq+sum_generation)/120.
bootstrap_execution.percentiles: Sort the 10,000 replicate scores. For p=0.025 and p=0.975 use h=(N-1)*p and linearly interpolate between floor(h) and ceil(h): Hyndman-Fan type 7 / NumPy default linear convention.
bootstrap_execution.runtime_receipt: Record the Python runtime version used for report assembly.

scope: This addendum affects diagnostic interval endpoints only. It changes no point estimate, item score, model ranking, competence threshold, tie-break, or backbone verdict.
